# DevPass by Vichar

> DevPass is a flat-price subscription for AI coding tools. One API key connects the models in the live [DevPass catalogue](https://devpass.vichar.io/models) in any OpenAI-compatible coding agent — DevPass Code, Claude Code, opencode, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Continue, and more — with a fixed monthly usage allowance instead of surprise token bills. Once the allowance is used, requests pause by default; users can optionally enable pay-as-you-go overflow and top up a credits balance to keep going at provider rates.

## Plans

- Lite: $29/month — includes $87 of model usage at standard provider rates.
- Pro: $79/month — includes $237 of model usage.
- Max: $179/month — includes $537 of model usage.
- Every plan includes model access and cost tracking; check the live catalogue for availability.
- First-month guarantee: refund yourself from the dashboard within 14 days if you've used less than 20% of your monthly allowance.

## Key pages

- [DevPass](https://devpass.vichar.io): Plans, supported coding agents, and setup.
- [Pricing](https://devpass.vichar.io/pricing): Lite, Pro, and Max plans with included usage, premium fair-use limits, and Reset Passes.
- [Pricing (machine-readable)](https://devpass.vichar.io/pricing.md): Plain-markdown DevPass pricing for AI agents.
- [Compare](https://devpass.vichar.io/compare): DevPass vs Cursor, OpenCode, FirePass, the z.ai GLM Coding Plan, and Alibaba's Qwen plan.
- [Claude Code alternative](https://devpass.vichar.io/claude-code-alternative): Keep the Claude Code CLI, replace the Max subscription.
- [Coding models](https://devpass.vichar.io/models): Every model on DevPass, filterable by tier, capability, provider, price, and context.
- [Setup guides](https://devpass.vichar.io/guides): Step-by-step setup for each coding agent.
- [Model Census](https://devpass.vichar.io/data): Yearly value, quality, and speed ratings from developers with verified usage.
- [Leaderboard](https://devpass.vichar.io/leaderboard): Developers ranked by tokens routed through DevPass.
- [Docs & agent guides](https://docs.vichar.io/guides): Detailed integration docs per coding agent.
- [Vichar](https://app.vichar.io): The open-source gateway platform DevPass runs on.
- [Platform pricing (machine-readable)](https://app.vichar.io/pricing.md): Plain-markdown pricing for the whole platform.

## Notes

- DevPass works with any tool that speaks the OpenAI API format — point it at the gateway base URL.
- Usage allowances are metered at provider list rates; there is no markup on tokens.
- DevPass always smart-routes each request to the best provider; pinning a specific provider (provider-prefixed model IDs) is not available on DevPass — use Vichar's pay-as-you-go API for provider pinning.
